text:
Jordan (Support): EaveLabs onboarding blocked — embedding API returning 403s starting 10:04 AM PST. They can't proceed with ingest. Renewal check-in in ~12 days, marking high priority :rotating_light:

Alex (CSM): Ugh. Can you paste the call and account id? I'll own the customer comms once we know what's happening.

Jordan (Support): Account: eave-67890
Request/response:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_XXXXX' -d '{"input":"doc text"}'

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"quota_exceeded","message":"no_active_quota"}
```

Priya (CS Ops): Looking at eave-67890 in admin: plan=trial, active_quota=0, billing_status=invoice_failed. Likely provisioning/payment gap.

Sam (AE): Customer told me yesterday they're on a tight timeline. If onboarding stalls they may not convert. We should escalate.

Alex (CSM): Quick playbook idea:
- Temp unblock: emergency quota bump (CS Ops) :zap:
- Ops: confirm backend logs & error category (support)
- Sync: 30m call with champion + product to capture feedback (CS + AE)
- Business: flag as renewal-risk and prep an uplift package if needed (AE)
Owners: Priya (ops bump), Jordan (logs + smoke test), Alex (customer comms & ticket), Sam (commercial follow-up).

Priya (CS Ops): Requesting temp quota bump now. ETA 15-25m. Adding audit entry.

BillingBot: Billing event: eave-67890 — last_payment_status=FAILED (card_declined). Recovery email sent to billing@eavelabs.com at 1792110012.

Jordan (Support): Logs show they hit a huge batch_size by default (batch_size=500) which exhausted vector quota immediately. Also saw intermittent 401s earlier — possibly stale key retries.

Alex (CSM): Draft to customer after we unblock (will tailor):
"Hi <Champion> — we identified a provisioning issue that prevented embeddings. We've applied a temporary increase so you can continue onboarding. Would you be available for a short call tomorrow to review and gather feedback? We'll also open an internal ticket to ensure this doesn't recur. Sorry for the interruption."

Sam (AE): I'll prepare a short ROI/upgrade outline to discuss on the call.

Priya (CS Ops): Temporary quota increase applied at 1792110180: +75k vectors/day for 72 hours. Noted as 'temp-unblock-eave-67890'.

Jordan (Support): Re-tested with customer — embeddings now succeed. They confirmed latency dropped when they set batch_size to 16.

Alex (CSM): Next steps:
- Jordan: send invite for 9:00 AM PT tomorrow (30m) and include product PM.
- Priya: follow up with billing to confirm payment recovery and discuss permanent quota changes.
- Alex: open internal ticket for PM/Eng with repro and customer-impact notes.

Jordan (Support): Customer feedback to capture for product:
- Want ability to set default batch_size per project
- Request smaller embedding dimension presets to trade off latency/cost
- Concerned about cold-start latency on first request after idle
- Wants an SLA for embeddings during trial for high-touch accounts

Alex (CSM): I'll create the ticket and tag PM, eng and include an eval set for regression checks. Also marking account as renewal-risk in CRM until after post-call outcome.

Sam (AE): Looping in renewal owner and internal exec sponsor with a brief update and call details.

Jordan (Support): Customer confirmed onboarding flow resumed. From support POV this is resolved; leaving open for CS ops + billing follow-ups.

Alex (CSM): Thanks everyone. I'll post the customer comms and meeting notes here after the call. :thumbsup:
